build_source_binding: No C/library/build/actualAPI PASS is supplied. The final actual v2 receipt must pin source_sha256 and this schema with a fresh parent ready.

source.boundary_proof: Inherited complete entry-through-RET linear body; no LDR, call or branch; not inferred from a neighboring function or index size alone. No claim about all possible indirect entries.
source.input_abi: w0 is a direct u32 value. Incoming x0 is never dereferenced by this body. full64 x0 must be retained; only low32 is the STR operand. Neither zero upper32 nor pointer semantics is required.
source.input_pointer_case: This producer is not the pointer case. If future inherited source only establishes a pointer argument, retain raw register only, proposed_u32=unknown and input_kind=unknown_pointer; do not dereference it or add a site without closed source.

sites.raw_input_u32: uint32_t(x0_raw) from the same exact8 x0 read
sites.proposed_u32: unknown; entry names the raw argument, not a reached store
sites.caller_raw: exact8 full64 x30; no mask, tag removal, caller range gate, invented callsite or LR allowlist

sites.proposed_u32: uint32_t(x0_raw), the actual source register of the pending original STR
sites.destination_rule: Record full64 x1_raw. Checked uint64 addition x1_raw+0x2f0 must equal B+0x7e6a7c8 without overflow; expected x1=B+0x7e6a4d8. Do not dereference destination. A mismatch is a bounded fault and no complete successful pre-store row.
sites.caller_raw: exact8 full64 x30; source body has no BL or LR write, but do not pair this row to an entry invocation by ordinal alone

translation.event_pc: Copied insn_vaddr for the selected instruction in the exact same-TB six-instruction anchor; no cross-TB reconstruction.
translation.base: B=anchor_entry-0x276e710; nonzero, page aligned, untagged zero-extended low48, complete anchor and checked static destinations within uint64/allowed low48 bounds.
translation.copy_api: Official API7 qemu_plugin_insn_data(insn, local4, 4) must return exactly 4 for each size4 instruction with continuous addresses. Compare all 24 inherited bytes, including uninstrumented second STR and RET.
translation.callbacks: Only before-instruction QEMU_PLUGIN_CB_R_REGS at indices 0 and 3. No callback for second STR or RET.
translation.pc_semantics: gdb_pc_raw is exact8 but may be lazy at either site. event_pc comes from immutable translation metadata. Do not require raw PC equality or silently replace it with event_pc; actualAPI fixture must demonstrate correct operand registers at both taps.
translation.userdata: Use the existing flat64-host opaque packed eventPC/site integer convention; derive B/site with checked fixed offsets, never dereference userdata. No retained insn handle, guest pointer, per-TB heap allocation or mutable callback metadata.
translation.ordinary_collisions: Before an exact producer anchor is known, low12 mismatch/partial TB/size/copy/byte mismatch is silent and consumes no success or fault quota. Unrelated PCs remain silent after binding. Exact known producer entry changing bytes/shape/continuity/remaining span disables evidence as producer_anchor_changed.
translation.scope_unchanged: Existing scope/poweron/late raw semantics remain; this proposal adds only independent producer candidate state and conflict checks. Existing poweron multi-base raw rows remain unbound.

register_contract.required: Clear GByteArray storage and length before each read; descriptor found is independent of handle!=NULL. Official qemu_plugin_read_register returns bool true and exact length: pc/x0/x1/x30=8, cpsr=4. Same exact8 read feeds x30_raw and caller_raw; no truncated reread.
register_contract.optional_present: Enumerated descriptor -> attempted read must bool true/exact8, otherwise fault rejects the entire row.
register_contract.optional_absent: available=0x0, raw=unknown, read_length=0x0, api_ok=unknown; never zero-fill a token.
register_contract.context_fields: cpsr_raw 8 hex digits; cpsr_m=cpsr_raw&0x1f 2 digits; nzcv=cpsr_raw&0xf0000000 8 digits; nzcv_mask=0xf0000000. nRW bit0x10 must be clear; modes 0,4,5,8,9,12,13 retained. CPU0 only.
register_contract.other_value_fields: x0_raw,x1_raw,x30_raw,caller_raw,gdb_pc_raw,event_pc,candidate_base use full 16 lowercase hex digits after 0x; raw_input_u32/proposed_u32 use 8 when known; no value filtering, no W0==1 assumption.
register_contract.prestore_read_budget_max: 8 attempted reads, 60 target bytes: pc/x0/x1/x30/sp/TTBR0/TLS 7*8 plus CPSR4; absent optional reads are not attempted.
register_contract.entry_read_budget_max: 7 attempted reads, 52 target bytes: omit x1; x1 fields absent in entry site schema.

candidate_and_identity.producer_candidate_state: At first complete exact producer translation freeze one provisional entry/base independently of scope candidate. This is an unclaimed code-pattern candidate, never a module/AP identity. Store only fixed bounded state; no producer_candidate record family is required.
candidate_and_identity.early_execution: Register callbacks immediately even before scope is discovered. On actual callback, emit observed full64 registers and tokens with scope_anchor_seen=0x0, identity=unknown,binding=unbound. Never delay, replay, fill or rewrite these rows.
candidate_and_identity.late_scope: Later scope candidate must equal provisional producer B. Same-B early raw rows remain unchanged; new reader may report retrospective_context_match_only, with earlier_AP_identity_unknown=true, if actual same-run Main/poweron and exact context tokens match. No fabricated earlier Main observation or earlier scope anchor.
fail_closed: Any second exact producer anchor at a different B disables the whole new evidence set, including earlier rows, even before scope discovery.
Producer B and scope B conflict in either discovery order: disable, retain conflicting full64 bases and an ambiguity fault/end state, no join.
Existing second scope B or known-anchor changes retain existing fail-closed behavior.
No exact producer callback records means normal input/caller/proposed value unknown, even when an anchor was translated.
No same-run Main binding, absent/short token or mode mismatch leaves raw producer rows uncorrelated; it is not proof of missing initialization/write.
candidate_and_identity.context_join: Parent validates frozen same-run assets/normal owned exit/full immutable trace. Original Main 35-field dispatch base/controller/caller/raw joins actual poweron record as before. Producer B must equal bound Main/scope B; CPU0, cpsr_m=0 EL0t, enumerated+successful exact8 TTBR0_EL1 and TPIDR_EL0 must numerically match that bound context. Exact raw tokens and availability are mandatory, absent != absent. Existing scope/late later-order rule is preserved; early producer matches get a distinct retrospective status only.
candidate_and_identity.EL1: Retain raw known AArch64 EL1 modes as other_aarch64 and unbound; never normalize to EL0t or claim original AP. AArch32/reserved or invalid mode is a bounded fault; no complete successful row.
candidate_and_identity.caller_followup: A correlated actual entry raw caller LR is the next precise source-selection key. Keep full64 raw, optionally derive LR-B arithmetically if checked in-range; LR-4 is only a candidate call instruction address, not proof of BL/BLR or dispatch. A future separately bounded inherited-source check must show that actual instruction and registration/slot consumer before assigning M ID/key/record grammar. No broad caller/writer/table scan is authorized by this contract.
candidate_and_identity.normality: The plugin observes invocation; 'normal original caller' requires later source/event evidence. Main context correlation alone does not establish normal dispatch or a transaction ID.
candidate_and_identity.PID_TID: Always unknown in plugin. Parent may cite same-run Main raw LF/PID/TID as reported line references, never label token or producer callback with proven PID/TID.

generation2.reader_routing: Explicit schema/profile version selected from actual begin plus reviewed runtime receipt; schema SHA must equal the new frozen ready pin. Reject unknown versions and v1 logs supplied as v2. Keep existing check_run_context.py and v1 schema/README/historical receipts/logs unmodified. Share/factor only smallest safe token/parser logic if necessary, preserving strict v1 schema, exact keys, bounds and validation.
generation2.constant_family_values: callback_phase=before_instruction, anchor_length=0x18,input_kind=u32_value; entry proposed_u32=unknown, pre_M_store proposed_u32=low32(x0_raw), destination_match=0x1 only after checked equality. No fabricated current_M or committed_M field.
generation2.begin_additions: schema=readonly_scope_v2, producer_sites=0x2, producer_quota=0x10, producer_anchor_length=0x18; no new RPC/guest event channel.
generation2.end_additions: producer_anchor_found, producer_base, producer_conflicting_base, producer0_records, producer1_records, producer_sequence; producer counts count only successfully emitted complete flushed rows. stop/ambiguity cover new conflict/anchor_changed reasons. No row does not mean no invocation or write.
generation2.limits: 16 successful rows per producer site, independent of two scope16, poweron16 and three late16. Existing shared fault budget32, saturating fault/suppression counts, line<2048, body formatting bounds and exclusive wx host log retained. No added producer_candidate line; maximum=131+2*16=163 lines, at most 333824 bytes using the conservative existing 2048-byte line envelope. Parent must verify formatter body1536 still accommodates longest producer row.
generation2.default: Off without explicit matched v2 build receipt under existing single-vCPU functional profile; do not silently opt existing v1 build/run into v2.

caller_followup: Observed full64 LR is only a next bounded source-selection key. LR-B or LR-4, if checked later, remains a candidate; no registered consumer/ID/key/enum/normality can be assigned.
remaining_unknown: causal pairing of distinct entry and pre-store records without adequate actual sequence/context evidence
earlier module/AP identity and global PID/TID/address-space uniqueness
historical_context: Original05b0 seven-line evidence and earlier rc0 are inherited conclusions only; no original run/log/console/card was reopened and no consumer rerun.
